description: The framework linking chronic social stress to disease: dysregulation across cardiovascular, metabolic, immune, sympathetic and HPA-axis systems - the 'wear and tear' that accumulates through repeated stress exposure. It rises between ages 20 and 60.
energy_note: The bill arrives twenty years later, itemised as something else.

description: A study of 1,714 migrants in Spain found discrimination and psychological distress predicted cardiovascular risk, with distress mediating the relationship - and the association held with socioeconomic variables controlled.
source_name: Perceived Discrimination, Psychological Distress and Cardiovascular Risk in Migrants in Spain

aspect: The pain link is weaker than people assume
description: Chronic pain and fatigue appear associated with mild HYPOcortisolism - a different HPA pathway from the hypercortisol pattern of acute stress. Standard allostatic load indices may not capture discrimination-related pain well, and pain is underrepresented in this literature.
energy_note: The back pain is probably real and is not well proven.
notes: HONEST LIMIT. The user's back-pain intuition is biologically plausible and the evidence base is thin. Layer-5 target: the discrimination-pain literature specifically.

aspect: The immigrant paradox cuts the other way
description: Some research finds allostatic load LOWER in foreign-born people, who reported fewer experiences of discrimination alongside healthier diets and safer neighbourhoods. Migration is not uniformly bad for health, and saying so keeps the rest credible.
notes: Included deliberately. A dataset that only points one way is less useful.

description: Close relationships affect cardiovascular, immune and neuroendocrine functioning during stress. Passive, physical and verbal support all buffer cardiovascular stress responses - and in lab settings even strangers work.
energy_note: Company is not a consolation prize. It is the intervention.

aspect: SCENARIO - the thing the doctor cannot find
description: Omid's shoulder and lower back have hurt since 2023. Two physiotherapists, an X-ray and an MRI find nothing structural. He is told it is probably stress. He agrees, pays CAD 1,100 in physio, and does not mention the application.
energy_note: A symptom with no diagnosis and an obvious cause nobody writes down.

description: Hassan's brother emigrated to Sweden in 1998 and had a heart attack at 54. The family says it was the cigarettes. It was probably partly the cigarettes.
energy_note: Attributed to the visible cause, as it always is.
